customers.title: Parties, prospects and customers
customers.section360Description: The same person or organization can hold several roles. The record remains usable without a DTSC account.
customers.emptyDescription: Start by creating a prospect, customer, organization or person. Linking to a DTSC account remains optional.
customers.gettingStartedDescription: Create your first customer, add their contact details, then optionally propose a consent-based DTSC link.
customers.createDialogDescription: Manual creation is always available. Linking to DTSC is a separate, consent-based step.
customers.typeRolesDescription: Choose the business object before completing its contact details.
customers.contactDescription: Only information useful to the business relationship is requested.
customers.relationshipDescription: The record can be saved without an account. No automatic matching is performed.
customers.relationshipHelper: The exact address is used only to deliver the private invitation. The response remains neutral about whether an account exists.
customers.forceDuplicate: Create despite the duplicates shown after comparison
customers.noContactDescription: Add an authorized contact from the next edit action.
customers.noAddressDescription: The address can be completed without affecting the DTSC relationship.
customers.relationshipSectionDescription: The global account and business record remain two separate objects.
customers.relationshipType: Type: {{type}}. Benefits are granted only when the relationship is active.
customers.noRelationshipDescription: This record works normally without a global account. An invitation can be offered later.
customers.historyDescription: Opportunities, quotes, orders, contracts, documents and events remain available from their dedicated modules.
customers.duplicateWarning: Similar records already exist. Compare them, then explicitly confirm creation of a new record.
customers.invitationEmailRequired: An exact email address is required to send the private invitation.
customers.invitationPurpose: Allow this person to benefit from services associated with their relationship with {{organization}}.
